name: purchasing_contract
title: Purchasing contracts
description: Purchasing contracts. Select EKKO document category K and approved contract types; exclude purchase orders and scheduling agreements. Verify validity, value versus quantity contract, remaining target obligation and releases against the contract. Link account assignments and time-dependent conditions; release history is evidence, not a second purchase-order load. Supplier, CO/PS and account mappings require cross-domain approval.
tested_release: none (draft, ECC 6.0 on NetWeaver 7.40 SP08 assumed)
